title: Investor's representative built a 1 millinewton thruster in his garage
summary: Charles Buer tells of Investor's representative built a 1 millinewton thruster in his garage, about recent at unspecified garage, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: What do you mean? I already built one in my garage.

plain: A man named Charles Buer, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast in an episode about a claimed antigravity propulsion device, tells of a conversation with someone representing an investor. According to Buer, this person said, "What do you mean? I already built one in my garage," claiming he had made a small thruster producing about one millinewton, a very tiny push, at home. If true, it would mean such a device is simple enough to build in a garage.
